avoid_supplements.name: Ephedra/Ma Huang
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Sympathomimetic effects directly antagonize beta-blocker activity; risk of hypertensive crisis
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; counsel patient to avoid completely

avoid_supplements.name: Yohimbine
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Alpha-2 antagonist increases norepinephrine; counteracts bisoprolol's antihypertensive effects
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; may reduce efficacy

avoid_supplements.name: Ginseng (high dose)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May increase sympathetic activity and blood pressure; antagonizes beta-blocker effects
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid or use only under medical supervision with BP monitoring

caution_supplements.name: Licorice root
caution_supplements.mechanism: May cause sodium retention and potassium loss; can elevate blood pressure
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood pressure; limit duration and dose

caution_supplements.name: Coenzyme Q10
caution_supplements.mechanism: Beta-blockers may reduce CoQ10 levels; supplementation is generally safe and may be beneficial

caution_supplements.name: Hawthorn
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have additive cardiovascular effects; potential for enhanced hypotensive response
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood pressure and heart rate if combined

avoid_foods.name: High sodium foods (processed meats, fast food)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Sodium retention counteracts antihypertensive efficacy of bisoprolol
avoid_foods.action: Maintain low-sodium diet (<2.3g sodium daily); counsel on dietary modification

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit/grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may increase bisoprolol levels; effect typically modest
caution_foods.action: Avoid excessive consumption; monitor for increased beta-blocker effects if regular intake

caution_foods.name: High-potassium foods (bananas, spinach, avocado)
caution_foods.mechanism: Beta-blockers may cause potassium retention; excessive intake could elevate serum K+
caution_foods.action: Consume in moderation; monitor potassium levels periodically, especially in renal impairment

monitoring_notes: Monitor blood pressure, heart rate, and potassium levels regularly. Counsel patients on consistent dosing timing and to avoid abrupt discontinuation due to risk of rebound hypertension and tachycardia.
